item.text:
Use **Connectors** in Work. Connect Gmail, Google Drive, or Notion, then enable the relevant connector via `+` → **Tools**, or let Work select it automatically. Connectors access data from your connected accounts for the task; actions such as sending email or modifying files require approval. [Mistral: Connect tools with Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/connectors)

**Web Search** is different: it searches the public internet for current, sourced information, and can open specified webpages. It does not query your private Gmail, Drive, or Notion data. [Mistral: Search the web](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/web-search-open-url)
